name: Block Merge on Label

on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - labeled
      - unlabeled

jobs:
  block_merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Check for blocking labels
      id: check_labels
      run: |
        BLOCKING_LABELS=("do NOT merge yet" "s: on hold")
        PR_LABELS=$(jq -r '.pull_request.labels[].name' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
        
        for LABEL in "${BLOCKING_LABELS[@]}"; do
          if [[ "$PR_LABELS" == *"$LABEL"* ]]; then
            echo "This PR has a blocking label: $LABEL"
            exit 1
          fi
        done
        
        echo "No blocking labels found"
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Unblock Merge
      if: ${{ steps.check_labels.outcome == 'success' }}
      run: |
        echo "The PR does not have any blocking labels. Merging is allowed."

parts: Write a GitHub Action yml file that blocks the PR from merging when there is a label named "do NOT merge yet" or "s: on hold"

To create a GitHub Actions workflow that blocks a pull request from merging when it has a label named "do NOT merge yet" or "s: on hold," you can use the following YAML configuration:

```yaml
name: Block Merge on Label

on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - labeled
      - unlabeled

jobs:
  block_merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Check for blocking labels
      id: check_labels
      run: |
        BLOCKING_LABELS=("do NOT merge yet" "s: on hold")
        PR_LABELS=$(jq -r '.pull_request.labels[].name' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
        
        for LABEL in "${BLOCKING_LABELS[@]}"; do
          if [[ "$PR_LABELS" == *"$LABEL"* ]]; then
            echo "This PR has a blocking label: $LABEL"
            exit 1
          fi
        done
        
        echo "No blocking labels found"
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Unblock Merge
      if: ${{ steps.check_labels.outcome == 'success' }}
      run: |
        echo "The PR does not have any blocking labels. Merging is allowed."

```

This workflow is triggered whenever a pull request is labeled or unlabeled. It checks if the labels include any of the specified blocking labels. If any of the blocking labels are found, the workflow will exit with a non-zero status code, preventing the PR from being merged. If no blocking labels are found, the workflow allows the PR to be merged.

Make sure to save this YAML file in the `.github/workflows` directory in your repository. When you create a pull request with the "do NOT merge yet" or "s: on hold" label, the workflow will block the PR from being merged.
